_about: Pro's prices come from the App Store Connect exports in i18n/prices/ (In-App Purchases > Privaro Pro > Price Schedule; download the current prices as CSV). To update, replace those files and run build.py. i18n/countries.json maps App Store Connect's country names to ISO codes. The site guesses the visitor's country in their browser (time zone, then language settings); a country with no price falls back to the country of the page's language (lang_country), then to base.
